parameters.description:
`msg-to-pushy` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Pushy destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own Pushy destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Pushy destinations bound per enrollment.

Sign in at pushy.me and create an App (or open an existing one), then copy its Secret API Key as PUSHY_APIKEY. UnitySVC uses this key to authenticate push requests sent to the devices registered under that app.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Pushy destinations, direct
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Pushy destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

api_key.description: This enrollment's Pushy apikey. Paste it or pick one of your secrets; it is kept as a secret and not shown again.

targets.description: This enrollment's Pushy targets. Paste it or pick one of your secrets; it is kept as a secret and not shown again.
